gaps.explanation: Statement lines are the Total Proprietary Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund (p11, printed p15): charges for services 4,443,231 + sales taxes 443,665 + miscellaneous 102,118 + interest and investment revenue 48,566 + insurance claims reimbursements 88,394 = 5,125,974. Detail is the ACCRUAL-basis Enterprise Fund Accounts combining schedule (pp15-16, printed pp52-53), Light/Water/Sewer/Sanitation/Others columns: charges 4,447,596 + sales taxes 446,180 + miscellaneous 102,118 + interest 47,166 + insurance property proceeds 88,394 = 5,131,454. Gap -5,480 has two parts: (1) missing fund column: the p11 Internal Service Fund column prints interest and investment revenue 1,400 (statement interest 48,566 = Enterprise 47,166 + Internal Service 1,400) and Transfers in (out) 80,000; that fund has no schedule, so neither line is in detail (the 80,000 is the counterpart of the enterprise net transfers out (80,000) already in detail: Light (1,434,603) + Water 164,673 + Sewer 620,735 + Others 569,195). Both are added below (the transfers line is listed here because the report has no business-type transfers gap row). (2) different basis: accrual charges 4,447,596 vs cash 4,443,231 (+4,365) and sales taxes 446,180 vs 443,665 (+2,515). After the add: 5,131,454 + 1,400 = 5,132,854; 5,132,854 - 5,125,974 = 6,880 = 4,365 + 2,515, the printed basis difference (no fix possible).
